PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: Drum Feed Safety Clamp, Flexible Size White Chemical Filter, Black
PRODUCT_NAME: Drum Feed Safety Clamp, Flexible Size White Chemical Filter
DESCRIPTION:
Drum Feed Safety Clamp, Flexible Size White Chemical Filter.

A safe, fast, effective way to increase the safety of your chemical feed system. Clamp is made of polypropylene and available in many colors to reduce cross-contamination of chemicals, by color-coding safety devices to chemical drums. Filter has a radial cut to accommodate various tubing sizes. Ideal for anyone who uses chemical feeds and Clean-in-place (CIP) methods.

Only for use with plastic drums. Do not use with metal drums.

Features:

  • Our Most Popular Style
  • As a general rule, these drum locks fit standard plastic UN chemical drums between 15-gallon and 55-gallon that feature a 2" opening with a flange. The precise size range that it will fit is 85mm-92mm. If the widest part of your drum opening is within this range, the clamp will fit securely.
    • for Canadian drums, we can install an adhesive foam strip at your request to enable the clamp to fit on the slightly smaller opening typically found on Canadian-made drums.
  • Fits most sizes of feed hoses, tubes, etc.
  • Includes cross-linked, closed-cell, copolymer filter that provides optimum chemical resistance
  • Memory properties allow the enhanced filter to close around the feed tube or probe and retain perfect shape for the next drum change-out
  • Includes 1 black EPDM tapered plug
  • Filter is white, which allows the end user to visually see when they should replace the filter
  • Recommended for all water treatment applications, including where a high-strength acid or base are involved
  • Recommended for cleaning & sanitation applications, including feed systems where multiple tubes and/or probes are being used in the same bung opening
  • Clamp can be applied or removed at any time during chemical feed operation
  • Can be used in conjunction with a Drum Seal Tag (# CFS-1014_10pk), for compliance with the FDA FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act). It allows you to seal a chemical drum, while feeding product.


Standard Chemical Filter (best seller): White media makes it easy to determine when to replace the filter. Radial cut design is flexible and allows for use with a range of tubing sizes, from standard 3/8" OD chemical feed tubing all the way up to 1" (although we recommend the All-in-One filter for larger tubing.) This filter has a "memory" which allows it to form around your feed tubing even if the tubing is at a slight angle or is not a common size. Easy to switch between different tubing sizes due to the flexibility of the material.
Density rating: LD15
Default hole size: Approximately 7-8mm

Benefits:

  • Easy to use and cost-effective solution to Chemical Feed Problems
  • Reduces risk of direct chemical exposure due to "splashing"
  • Improves "Indoor Air Quality" (IAQ) - helpful for OSHA inspections
  • Reduces contamination of the chemical product by helping to eliminate any dirt, debris, moisture, or environmental hazards from entering the drum
  • Aids to reduce cross-contamination by using color-coded Safety Clamps on chemical drums.
  • Creates a "greener" work environment, which aids employee's health
  • Solid Filter and Drum Seal Tags enable proper Lock out, Tag out procedure for safe storage of chemicals

Drum Lock Safety Clamp is used in the following industries:

  • Beverage Processing
    • Dairy
    • Brewery / Distillation
    • Water / Soda / Etc.
  • Institutional
    • General water treatment
    • Pools & Spas
    • Car Washes
  • Hospitality
  • Pharmaceuticals
  • Chemical Processing
  • Power Generation / Utilities
  • Refining
  • Mining
  • Ethanol
  • Food Manufacturing
  • Semi-Conductor
  • Pulp & Paper
  • Health Care
  • Laundry
  • Design & Build Engineering Services
  • Contract Manufacturing
